description: Recommended values for an exercise's classification.exerciseType. Open by policy: an unrecognised value is a classification this registry has not caught up with, not an invalid document.

entries.label: Strength
entries.description: Resistance work whose intent is force production. Loaded, low to moderate repetitions.

entries.label: Hypertrophy
entries.description: Resistance work whose intent is muscle growth. Moderate load, moderate to high repetitions, accumulated volume.

entries.label: Power
entries.description: Explosive work where velocity is the point — Olympic derivatives, jumps, throws.

entries.label: Cardio
entries.description: Sustained work measured by duration, distance or output rather than repetitions.

entries.label: Conditioning
entries.description: Mixed-modal work under time pressure. Distinguished from cardio by the presence of resistance elements.

entries.label: Endurance
entries.description: Long-duration steady work. A cardio subtype named separately because programs routinely distinguish the two.

entries.label: Mobility
entries.description: Work whose intent is usable range of motion — active, under control.

entries.label: Flexibility
entries.description: Passive lengthening. Distinct from mobility, which is range you can produce rather than range you can be placed in.

entries.label: Balance
entries.description: Work whose intent is postural control and stability under challenge.

entries.label: Plyometric
entries.description: Stretch-shortening cycle work. A power subtype where ground contact time is the variable of interest.

entries.label: Skill
entries.description: Practice of a movement pattern where technique, not load or fatigue, is the target.

entries.label: Rehabilitation
entries.description: Prescribed corrective or return-to-function work. Recorded as intent; FDS carries no clinical claim.

entries.label: Warm-up
entries.description: Preparatory work performed to raise readiness rather than to accumulate training stress.
